topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 34 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (versionedinitializable, lendingpoolstorage, debttokenbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
